easyPrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy by paying {W} due to its affinity for creatures.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Recruit the Worthy, creating a creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
